rows.title: The performance suite's readiness probe follows the INS home's heading when the overall home lands
rows.detail: The performance suite's 'INS signed-in page' readiness probe matches the INS home's main heading exactly. It must change in the same increment that changes the home's heading to 'Import notification service', or every performance run's readiness fails after 300 seconds. That heading change belongs to the overall INS home, which waits until the front door dashboard's requirements firm up, so the probe waits with it.
acceptanceCriteria: The 'INS signed-in page' readiness probe passes when the home answers 200 to a signed-in trader with the main heading 'Import notification service' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-040; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-075, p3-076)
The 'address book read' readiness probe still passes when the front door's address book answers 200 with the heading 'Address book' (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-041)

The stack counts as functionally ready only when one pass succeeds for all six readiness probes, and readiness otherwise fails after 300 seconds naming the probes that failed (repo:perftests repo-perftests-p2-042)
openQuestions: Blocked: the probe matches the INS home's heading exactly (c-146), so it changes only in the increment that changes that heading, and that increment is blocked until the front door dashboard's requirements firm up and are agreed (ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm claim 52). Who: whoever owns the front door dashboard's requirements must firm them up and agree them with Sam.
rows.notes: existingRow inc-128: req-1905 already sits in the overall INS home row, blocked, with req-1848's other performance-suite checks of the same heading. Its three readiness criteria are already in inc-128 word for word, so the combiner should merge this draft into inc-128 and keep one copy, not a second row. The probe lives in perftests src/k6/readiness.js, which no split-off theme touches, so this is not a splitOff entry; the heading it follows lives in the INS dashboard feature folder that the split-off type-question-and-templates theme owns, which is why that folder is shared, not touched, as inc-128's notes already say.

rows.title: Germinal products pages carry the shared service chrome, scoped to the germinal set
rows.detail: Germinal products is its own set beside live animals, mounted at its own prefix in the animals frontend. Every germinal page carries the same chrome as a live animals page, and the set-scoped parts (the home link, the current navigation item and the error page chrome) resolve inside the germinal set. The set's root shows its own notification list, copied from the live animals list as it is today. The shared layout already resolves these per set by mount prefix, so this is the germinal set supplying its configuration, not a layout change.
acceptanceCriteria: Every germinal products page shows the 'Import notification service' service navigation with the same items, in the same order, as a live animals page (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006, -p1-009; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-009)
Every germinal products page shows the Alpha phase banner with its feedback link, and the footer, as live animals pages do (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Every germinal products page's browser title reads '<page title> - Import notification service - GOV.UK', with 'Error: ' in front when the page shows validation errors (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-006)

Germinal products journey pages show the same section captions, back links, error summary and banners as the live animals page each one is copied from (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-009, -p1-011)

On every germinal products page the service name and the Dashboard navigation item link to the germinal products set's own root at /germinal-products, and following either one shows the germinal products notification list (ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-008; ruling:sam-2026-10-09-pm ruling-sam-2026-10-09-pm-p3-103, -p3-104; ruling:sam-2026-11-27 ruling-sam-2026-11-27-p1-021, -p1-022; repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-013, repo-frontend-p2-128)

Dashboard is the current navigation item at the germinal products set's root and on every page inside a germinal products notification (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-009; ruling:sam-2026-10-09 ruling-sam-2026-10-09-p1-011)

Opening an address under /germinal-products that does not exist shows 'Page not found' in the germinal set's chrome, with the service name linking to /germinal-products (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-131, repo-frontend-p2-132; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p13-058)

Opening an address that falls under no set shows 'Page not found' with the service name linking to the service root (repo:frontend repo-frontend-p2-156; repo:plantsfrontend repo-plantsfrontend-p13-058)
